_comment: Mapping of the specification identifier (UBL cbc:CustomizationID / CII rsm:ExchangedDocumentContext/ram:GuidelineSpecifiedDocumentContextParameter/ram:ID, normalize-space applied) to the rule sets to execute. Data only; documented in docs/RULESETS.md. Evaluation: the entries of the document's syntax are tested in order, the first match wins. match = 'exact' (string equality) or 'prefix' (starts-with). ruleSets are ids of build/schemas/<id>.json, executed in the given order, findings are united. xsd = id of build/xsd/<id>.json; 'by-root' = UBL-Invoice-2.1 / UBL-CreditNote-2.1 by root element. delegate = 'scenarios.json' means: the KoSIT scenario selection (build/scenarios.json) is authoritative for this identifier (identical rule sets and customLevel handling).

UBL.note: prefix match = PEPPOL-EN16931-R004 (starts-with; R004 itself rejects '::' version suffixes). Covers national extensions such as ...#compliant#urn:www.difi.no:ehf:ver3.0; ProfileID (BT-23) selects profile 01 / 02 inside PEPPOL-UBL ($profile). Peppol itself bundles CEN TC434 1.3.14.1 (rules/sch/CEN-EN16931-UBL.sch); this tool uses CEN 1.3.16.

CII.note: the only id in codedb cl 1 of FACTUR-X_EN16931; the same id denotes plain EN 16931 CII. Embedded in a PDF (Factur-X/ZUGFeRD) the profile XSD applies (Mustang); a standalone CII without PDF container is EN 16931 syntax-bound to CII D16B (xsdStandalone). FACTUR-X-EN16931 contains the BR-* rules of EN 16931 but none of the CII-SR-*, CII-DT-* and BR-CL-* rules, hence EN16931-CII is executed as well (Mustang XMLValidator.java l. 422-423).
